messages:
eri: Heads-up: opened PR to rework private/VPC install guide. It splits preflight checks into a small conncheck script, adds HSM PKCS#11 mounting notes, a USB-HSM bridge section for semi-airgapped installs, and a short compatibility table for iptables-nft vs iptables-legacy. PR: https://github.com/redwood/docs/pull/4389
marta: Love the split. Ops asked for a single-file conncheck.sh in examples/ they can run during onboarding. Keep it tiny and idempotent.
li: I can author conncheck.sh. Which checks should we include? I'm thinking: dualstack (IPv4/IPv6), MTU sanity, DNS resolution for control plane endpoints, outbound-only firewall test, and ports for KMS/HSM.
eri: Port callouts: example KMS 8500/tcp, HSM SDK 22600/tcp, ntp 123/udp. Add note to document that these are examples and customers must replace with their endpoints. Also mention nftables snippet and iptables compatibility.
marta: For sealed sites recommend nftables by default, but keep an iptables-legacy snippet for older distros. Also call out nf_conntrack_max issue — older kernels hit defaults; add a mitigation (sysctl).
li: Draft conncheck.sh snippet: ```bash
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail
# quick preflight: dualstack, MTU, DNS, port checks
ping -c1 -W1 8.8.8.8 || echo "ipv4 unreachable"
ping -c1 -W1 -6 2001:4860:4860::8888 || echo "ipv6 unreachable (ok if you don't run dualstack)"
MTU=$(ip link show dev eth0 | awk -F"mtu " '{print $2}' | awk '{print $1}')
echo "mtu=$MTU"
# DNS check
getent hosts control.redwood.example || echo "DNS for control plane failed"
# port check (tcp)
for p in 8500 22600; do nc -vz -w2 control.redwood.example $p || echo "port $p closed"; done
```
infra-bot: CI linkcheck: offline/signing-key.gpg -> 404. See job 4389.
docs-bot: I suggested alternative mirror URL and added SHA256 verification sample. Please sanity-check the gpg verify snippet before merge.
marta: Quick systemd nit: use Type=notify for hsm-agent so readiness is propagated and add RestartSec=5. Also add ExecStartPre to ensure the pkcs11 socket dir exists. Example: ```ini
[Unit]
Description=Redwood HSM agent
After=network-online.target

[Service]
Type=notify
ExecStartPre=/bin/mkdir -p /var/run/pkcs11-socket
ExecStart=/usr/local/bin/hsm-agent --config /etc/redwood/hsm.yaml
Restart=on-failure
RestartSec=5
PIDFile=/run/hsm-agent.pid
```
eri: Good. Also include a short socat example for USB-HSM bridging (semi-airgap): how to forward /dev/ttyUSB0 -> unix socket, and note the security considerations (udev rules + ephemeral socket perms).
marta: Will add udev snippet and a short note about mapping /dev devices into containers with proper device cgroup permissions.
docs-bot: I updated the PR with the alternate mirror URL and checksum sample. Left one inline comment about wording for "sealed site" vs "sealedsite" (consistency).

eri: Plan: merge after 12:00 PST today if no blockers. Labels: docs:private, backport/1.3. If anything else crops up, leave a PR comment and we'll address in followups. Closing thread here.
